description: Elisabeth and Franz face the demands of succession, family and imperial politics as personal losses and growing unrest test both their marriage and Elisabeth’s place within the monarchy.

s02e01.description: Pressure intensifies on Elisabeth to produce a male heir, while a state visit exposes the imperial family to unrest and reminds Franz how fragile the monarchy’s authority has become.

s02e02.description: Franz sends Maximilian to court Napoleon III as a potential ally, while Sophie maneuvers to reduce Elisabeth’s influence over her own children and tighten control inside the palace.

s02e03.description: Elisabeth travels through Lombardy-Venetia in an effort to repair the monarchy’s reputation, while Franz gives Maximilian a politically sensitive chance to prove where his loyalty lies.

s02e04.description: Leontine asks Alexander to flee with her, but his discovery changes their plans, while Elisabeth and Franz’s visit to Hungary ends in a tragedy that reshapes the family’s future.

s02e05.description: Overwhelmed by grief and court pressure, Elisabeth retreats to her family in Bavaria, giving Sophie an opening to pursue a replacement match for Franz and protect the succession on her own terms.

s02e06.description: As the Austrian Empire slides into war, Elisabeth fights to hold her family together and Franz faces the consequences of political choices made around him, while Sophie discovers the cost of her own interference.
